stem: On a perpendicular graphical net representing Q on both axes, plot the point $C(-3,-\frac{3}{2})$. Tap the point.
solution: Move 3 units left along the x-axis.
Move 1.5 units down, halfway between -1 and -2.

hints.text: The first number is the position along the horizontal axis and the second is the height.
Check the sign of each number to see which way to move.
Write the fraction as a decimal first, then count along each axis in steps of one half.
